name: seo-blog-generator
description: Turn any company-ranking CSV into an SEO-optimised server-rendered blog page

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name seo-blog-generator
scripts.lint: eslint server/ pages/ tests/ scripts/ nuxt.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint server/ pages/ tests/ scripts/ nuxt.config.ts --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write server/ pages/ tests/ scripts/ nuxt.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check server/ pages/ tests/ scripts/ nuxt.config.ts
